name: API Orchestrator - Analytics
description: Analytics dashboard with charts, timeline, endpoint performance, and status-code distribution for API Orchestrator request logs.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Analytics provides an admin analytics dashboard for API Orchestrator request data. AnalyticsDashboardController exposes AJAX JSON endpoints (stats, timeline, endpoints, distribution, requests) backed by parameterized aggregate SQL over the api_orchestrator_request table, rendered as charts via an SDC component and Chart.js. Filters cover service, endpoint, status, method, date range, duration and response code, with selectable time granularity. Requires api_orchestrator. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
